thread:
maria: Heads up: billing anomaly for cust_xyz. They saw provisional ~900 tokens in console, final confirmed ~700, but invoice shows ~1.6k. Root cause looks like streaming reconnect + tool_call retry.

josh: ouch. any traces?

maria: trace: trace_2026_05_07_77. timeline: client opens stream -> emits provisional slices -> triggers tool_call -> client reconnects (new websocket) -> router does handoff to fallback model -> truncated final. We emitted provisional twice.

lee: quick summary: provisional events are recorded per stream fragment and keyed by session_id. reconnect creates new session_id so ledger sees separate provisional groups. Finalization logic only dedupes by session_id + prefix range.

ana: can we attach a stable attempt identifier that survives reconnects for the same logical attempt? e.g., X-Redwood-Attempt header on the original request and propagated to reconnects.

maria: exactly. proposal: include billing_attempt_id in provisional events and in the final confirm event. Ledger dedupe rule: group by (customer, billing_attempt_id, token_range).

josh: implementation notes: add header to streaming API and to tool_call invocations. For clients that don't set it, router can synthesize one and propagate across reconnects using a short-lived cookie.

console-ux: UI change: default dashboard should show "confirmed" by default. Show provisional only when "Show provisional" toggle is on. Also add a small yellow banner: "Provisional numbers are estimates and may change during finalization."

ops-bot: Alert: spike detected cust_xyz provisional_tokens > 3x baseline at 2026-05-07T09:12Z.

lee: storage impact: adding attempt_id increases cardinality of provisional index keys. Current TTL is 7 days for provisional records; I think it's ok but will run a cost estimate.

ana: migration: consumers of the provisional queue should be updated to join on billing_attempt_id. We should keep backward compatibility: if billing_attempt_id missing, fall back to session_id behavior.

maria: telemetry plan: add metrics streaming.provisional_tokens_total, streaming.confirmed_tokens_total, billing.dedupe_collapses.total. Emit a tagged count per customer and per route.

josh: quick mitigation: front-end patch to hide provisional by default + new help text. That should reduce ops panic while engineers implement ledger changes.

maria: timeline suggestion: 1) console hide provisional (quick) 2) header + router propagation (medium) 3) ledger dedupe + migration (medium) 4) opt-in UI smoothing (longer).

lee: I'll open RFC and include a reproducible script that simulates: open stream, send a couple slices, trigger tool_call, force reconnect, resume with same billing_attempt_id. Will post link.

maria: please add unit tests for dedupe and an e2e in staging with synthetic traffic. Include billing/sre and legal in RFC cc.

josh: created ISSUE-4621 to track console patch. assigning to @josh.

nana: created ISSUE-4622 for API header + router propagation. assigning @lee.

maria: created ISSUE-4623 for ledger migration + dedupe implementation. assigning @maria.

billing-bot: InvoiceEvent: provisional emitted for cust_xyz evt_12345 at 2026-05-07T09:12:10Z.

maria: thanks all. small UX thing: console can temporarily grease the "provisional may be overstated" banner with a link to a short explainer doc. josh can you draft that?

josh: yes. will do.

lee: repro script ETA today. will run cost sim and post numbers by EOD.

maria: perfect. we'll sync in next standup if anything urgent pops up.
